qe: The 'Universal Law of Gravitation' was given by:
qh: 'गुरुत्वाकर्षण का सार्वत्रिक नियम' किसके द्वारा दिया गया था?
o: Newton (न्यूटन)
Kepler
Galileo
Copernicus
e: Concept: 'Universal Law of Gravitation' kehta hai ki brahmand ka har koi vastu doosri vastu ko apni taraf kheenchti hai, aur ye force dono ke mass ke gunanfal ke samanupati (directly proportional) aur unke beech ki doori ke varg ke vipreet (inversely proportional) hoti hai: F = G*m1*m2/r^2. Is niyam ko Sir Isaac Newton ne apni book 'Principia' (1687) me diya tha - isliye unhe 'gravity ka janak' bhi kehte hain. Kepler ne planet ke path ka niyam diya, Galileo ne gati ke experiment kiye. Exam point: 'Universal law of gravitation = Newton'.

qe: What is the 'Escape Velocity' from the Moon's surface?
qh: चंद्रमा की सतह से 'पलायन वेग' क्या है?
o: 1.6 km/s
5.0 km/s
e: Concept: Escape velocity = sqrt(2*g*R) hoti hai - jitna chhota grah ya chandrama hoga aur jitni kam uski gravity, utni kam escape velocity. Chandrama par g ki value lagbhag 1.6 m/s^2 hai aur radius chhota hai, isliye wahan escape velocity lagbhag 2.38 km/s hai (Prithvi ki 11.2 km/s se bahut kam). Isi wajah se chandrama se rocket bhejna aasan hai - kam fuel me kaam chal jata hai. Exam point: 'Moon ki escape velocity = 2.38 km/s (Earth = 11.2 km/s)'.

qe: According to Newton's Universal Law of Gravitation, the gravitational force of attraction acts between any two masses in the universe along which geometric path?
qh: न्यूटन के गुरुत्वाकर्षण के सार्वभौमिक नियम के अनुसार, दो द्रव्यमानों के बीच गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल किस मार्ग के अनुदिश कार्य करता है?
o: Along the line joining the centers of the two objects
Strictly horizontal to the surface plane
Symmetrically opposite to the rotation axis
Along a curved trajectory determined by the smaller mass
e: Concept: Do vastuon ke beech lagne wala gravitation force hamesha unke KENDRA (centre of mass) ko mila-ne wali seedhi REKHA ke along hota hai - yaani force ya to ek doosre ki taraf hota hai ya door, kisi tirche kone par nahi. Isi kaaran Earth apne kendra ki taraf sab kuch kheenchti hai. Force 'line joining the centers' ke along hone ke kaaran hi motion ka calculation simple ho jata hai. Horizontal ya axis ke around wale options galat hain. Exam point: 'Gravitation force = dono objects ke kendron ko milane wali line ke along'.

qe: Object A attracts Object B with a gravitational force F. According to Newton's third law of motion, with what force does Object B simultaneously attract Object A?
qh: वस्तु A, वस्तु B को गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल F से आकर्षित करती है। न्यूटन के तीसरे नियम के अनुसार, वस्तु B उसी क्षण वस्तु A को कितने बल से आकर्षित करती है?
o: With an equal and opposite force F
With zero force as only the larger mass pulls
With a force proportional to the surface area of B
With a significantly smaller force because A is larger
e: Concept: Newton ka teesra niyam: 'Har kriya (action) ke barabar aur vipreet pratikriya (reaction) hoti hai'. Isliye agar A, B ko F force se kheenchta hai, to B bhi A ko theek utne hi F force se kheenchta hai - balki wahi ek force hai jo dono par ulti disha me lagta hai. Isse chahe badi vastu ho ya chhoti, force ka magnitude hamesha barabar hota hai. Farq sirf acceleration me aata hai (chhoti vastu tez hil ti hai). Exam point: 'Action = -Reaction (barabar aur ulta force)'.

qe: What is the correct derived SI unit for the Universal Gravitational Constant (G)?
qh: सार्वभौमिक गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियतांक (G) के लिए सही व्युत्पन्न एसआई (SI) मात्रक क्या है?
o: N m kg^-1
N m^2 kg^-2
m s^-2
N m^-2 kg^2
e: Concept: Gravitation ka formula F = G*m1*m2/r^2 hai. Isse G ka unit nikalne ke liye G = F*r^2/(m1*m2) lagao: F ka unit newton (N), r^2 ka m^2, aur mass ka kg*kg - isliye G ka unit N m^2 kg^-2 banta hai, aur iski value 6.67 x 10^-11 N m^2 kg^-2 hoti hai. Ye value bahut hi chhoti hai, isliye aam chhoti vastuon me gravity ka asar mehsoos nahi hota. Exam point: 'G = 6.67 x 10^-11 N m^2 kg^-2'. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad N m^2 kg^-2 hi theek uttar hai. Is vishay ke ulte prashn bhi poochhe jaate hain, isliye dono taraf ka tathya saaf karna zaroori hai.

qe: Why do we not visibly feel or observe the gravitational force of attraction between ordinary everyday objects like two people sitting in a room?
qh: हम किसी कमरे में बैठे दो व्यक्तियों के बीच गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल को प्रत्यक्ष रूप से क्यों महसूस नहीं कर पाते हैं?
o: Because the force exists only in the presence of fluids
Because the value of G is extremely small, making the force negligible for small masses
Because atmospheric pressure cancels out the gravitation field
Because ordinary objects do not contain mass
e: Concept: Gravitation force hamesha maujood hoti hai, par uski value G (6.67 x 10^-11) aur mass ke gunanfal par nirbhar karti hai. Do aam logon ka mass lagbhag 60-70 kg hota hai, jisse force sirf math-bhaar (10^-7 N) banta hai - ye itna kamzor hai ki koi bhi khinchav mehsoos nahi hota. Jabki Earth ka mass 6 x 10^24 kg hai, isliye uski gravity saaf mehsoos hoti hai. Isliye 'aam vastu me force kam dikhne' ka kaaran G ki chhoti value hai, hawa ya pressure nahi. Exam point: 'G bahut chhota hai, isliye chhoti mass par gravitation force negligible'.

qe: According to the Inverse Square Law of gravitation, if the distance 'd' between two masses is doubled, the force becomes:
qh: यदि दो द्रव्यमानों के बीच की दूरी 'd' को दोगुना कर दिया जाए, तो गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल कितना हो जाएगा?
o: One-fourth (F/4)
Remains completely unchanged
Four times (4F)
Doubled (2F)
e: Concept: 'Inverse Square Law' kehta hai force doori ke varg (square) ke ulta hota hai: F ~ 1/r^2. Isliye doori 'd' se '2d' (dugni) karne par force (1/2)^2 = 1/4 ho jata hai. Ye niyam gravity ke saath-saath light, sound aur Coulomb force me bhi lagta hai. Sawal me doori badhne wale cases aate hain, isliye 'dugni doori = chauthai force' yaad rakhein. Exam point: 'Doori dugni = force chauthai (F/4)'. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar One-fourth (F/4) hi hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: What happens to the gravitational force between two masses if the distance between their centers is reduced to exactly half?
qh: यदि दो द्रव्यमानों के बीच की दूरी को घटाकर आधा कर दिया जाए, तो उनके बीच गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
o: It decreases to half (F/2)
It decreases to one-fourth (F/4)
It increases to four times (4F)
It remains absolutely the same
e: Concept: Inverse square law: F ~ 1/r^2. Agar doori AADHI (r/2) ho jaye, to naya force = G m1 m2/(r/2)^2 = 4 * (G m1 m2/r^2) = 4F. Yaani doori aadhi karne par gravitation force CHAAR guna badh jata hai. Isi sambandh se pata chalta hai ki doori kam karne par gravity ka asar bahut tez badhta hai. Doosre options me aadha ya same rehna galat hai. Exam point: 'Doori aadhi = force 4 guna'. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Is prashn ka theek jawab It increases to four times (4F) hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: What is the primary role of the centripetal force in maintaining the orbit of the Moon around the Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी के चारों ओर चंद्रमा की कक्षा में अभिकेंद्र बल (Centripetal Force) का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: It slows down the rotation of the Earth's axis
It pushes the Moon into outer space away from Earth
It continuously changes the direction of motion of the Moon, keeping it in a circular path
It increases the mass of the Moon continuously
e: Concept: Chandrama jab Earth ke around gol (circular) path me ghoomta hai, to uski CHAAL (speed) lagbhag same rehti hai par disha har pal badalti rehti hai. Disha badalne ke liye ek force chahiye jo hamesha center (Earth) ki taraf ho - isi ko 'centripetal force' (kendra-dishi bal) kehte hain. Ye force sirf disha badalta hai, speed nahi. Iske bina chandrama seedha bhaag jayega. Isliye iska kaam 'direction change kar ke circular path me rakhna' hai. Exam point: 'Centripetal force = disha lagatar badal kar circular path banaye rakhna'.

qe: In the case of the Moon revolving around the Earth, which actual physical force provides the required centripetal force?
qh: पृथ्वी के चक्कर लगाने वाले चंद्रमा के मामले में, कौन सा वास्तविक बल आवश्यक अभिकेंद्र बल प्रदान करता है?
o: The gravitational force of attraction between the Earth and the Moon
Magnetic repulsion of the polar grids
Atmospheric friction of free space
Electrostatic force of ionized particles
e: Concept: Chandrama ko gol path me rakhne wala centripetal force koi alag se force nahi, balki Earth aur Chandrama ke beech ka GRAVITATION FORCE hi hai. Yahi khinchav chandrama ko seedha bhaagne se rokta hai aur usse Earth ki parikrama (orbit) me bandhe rakhta hai. Isi kisam ke sambandh ko Newton ne 'Kepler ki parkrama' se joda tha. Magnetic repulsion, atmospheric friction ya electrostatic force iska kaaran nahi. Exam point: 'Moon ka centripetal force = Earth-Moon gravitation force'.

qe: If the gravitational force between the Earth and the Moon suddenly vanished into zero, how would the Moon theoretically move?
qh: यदि पृथ्वी और चंद्रमा के बीच का गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल अचानक शून्य हो जाए, तो चंद्रमा सैद्धांतिक रूप से कैसे गति करेगा?
o: It would fly off along a straight line tangent to its circular orbit
It would start moving in a smaller spiral counter-clockwise
It would fall straight to the center of the Earth
It would stop moving instantly and stay frozen
e: Concept: Circular motion me vastu ke velocity ki disha hamesha path ke TANGENT (sparsh rekha) ke along hoti hai, aur usse kendra ki taraf kheenchne wala force (centripetal) hi use mudata hai. Agar ye force achanak zero ho jaye, to mudane wala koi kaaran nahi bachega - matlab vastu apni usi disha me SEEDHI (straight line me) bhaag jayegi, jis disha me wo us samay jaa rahi thi. Ye Newton ke first law (inertia) ka seedha udaharan hai. Exam point: 'Gravity hat gayi to vastu tangent ke along seedhi bhaagegi (inertia se)'.

qe: Why is the acceleration of the Earth toward the Moon imperceptible even though both exert equal gravitational force on each other?
qh: चंद्रमा द्वारा लगाए गए समान बल के बावजूद पृथ्वी का चंद्रमा की ओर त्वरण नगण्य क्यों होता है?
o: Because the velocity of Earth is absolute in vacuum
Because the mass of the Earth is extremely large compared to the Moon (a = F/M)
Because the Moon does not exert any force on the Earth
Because Earth is protected by its magnetic field
e: Concept: Earth aur Chandrama ek doosre par barabar gravitation force lagate hain (Newton ka teesra niyam), par acceleration = force / mass hota hai. Earth ka mass 6 x 10^24 kg hai - bahut bada - isliye usi force se uski acceleration (a = F/M) itni chhoti (lagbhag 3.3 x 10^-5 m/s^2) hoti hai ki dikhai nahi deti. Chandrama ka mass chhota hai, isliye wo zyada tej acceleration ke saath ghoomta dikhta hai. Exam point: 'Earth ka mass bahut bada, isliye same force se uska acceleration bahut kam'.

qe: What is the scientific distinction between the 'Mass' of an object and its 'Weight'?
qh: किसी वस्तु के 'द्रव्यमान' (Mass) और उसके 'भार' (Weight) के बीच वैज्ञानिक अंतर क्या है?
o: Mass changes with location, Weight remains constant
Mass is measured in Newtons and Weight in Kilograms
Both are vector quantities measuring coordinates
Mass is the quantity of matter and stays constant everywhere, while Weight is the gravitational force acting on it (W = mg)
e: Concept: 'Mass' vastu me pada padarth (matter) ki maatra hai, jo har jagah sama rehti hai - Earth par ho ya chand par ya space station me, mass nahi badalta aur iska SI unit kilogram (kg) hai. 'Weight' wo force hai jo gravity vastu par lagata hai: W = m*g; isliye weight jagah ke saath badalta hai (chand par g kam hone se weight kam ho jata hai). Weight force hai isliye newton (N) me naapa jata hai, mass kg me. Isi kaaran dukan par saman 'weight' se bechta hua dihkta hai, par asal me mass hota hai. Exam point: 'Mass constant (kg) hai, Weight jagah se badalta hai (N)'.

qe: Where is the acceleration due to gravity (g) maximum and minimum on the surface of the Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी की सतह पर गुरुत्वीय त्वरण (g) का मान कहाँ अधिकतम और कहाँ न्यूनतम होता है?
o: Depends strictly on ocean tides
Maximum at the poles and minimum at the equator
Zero everywhere on the surface plane
Maximum at the equator, minimum at the poles
e: Concept: Prithvi ki shakal gol nahi balki dhruvon par thodi CHAPTI (oblate) hai - poles par radius kam aur equator par radius zyada hota hai. g = GM/R^2 hone ke kaaran radius badhne se g kam ho jati hai. Isliye poles par (radius kam) g ki value maximum (lagbhag 9.83 m/s^2) hoti hai, aur equator par (radius zyada + dharti ka ghumna bhi) g minimum (lagbhag 9.78 m/s^2) hoti hai. Exam point: 'g maximum = poles par, minimum = equator par'.

qe: If a trader buys gold by weight at the Earth's poles and sells it at the equator using a spring balance, what will be the result?
qh: यदि कोई व्यापारी ध्रुवों पर स्प्रिंग बैलेंस से तौलकर सोना खरीदे और भूमध्य रेखा पर बेचे, तो उसे क्या परिणाम मिलेगा?
o: He will gain a huge profit
The spring balance will not function
There will be no change since mass is absolute
He will experience a loss because the measured weight decreases at the equator
e: Concept: Halki cheez (jaise soona) 'weight' (W = mg) se tolte hain, aur g ki value poles par sabse zyada aur equator par sabse kam hoti hai. Isliye jo dukandar poles par weight se soona kharidta hai, wo zyada mass kharid leta hai (kam mass se zyada weight milta hai). Lekin equator par wo usi weight par kam mass dega. Is wajah se usko nuksan hoga. Mass same rehta, weight badalta hai - isliye spring balance par farq dikhta hai. Exam point: 'Poles par kharido, equator par becho = nuksaan (weight farq ke kaaran)'.

qe: How does the acceleration due to gravity (g) change as one moves deep inside a mine or high up into the atmosphere?
qh: पृथ्वी की सतह से ऊपर जाने पर या खदान में गहराई में जाने पर गुरुत्वीय त्वरण (g) के मान में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
o: It decreases in both cases
It remains absolutely constant at 9.8 m/s^2
It increases in both cases
It increases going up and decreases going down
e: Concept: g ki value formula g = GM/R^2 se aati hai, jisme R dharti ke kendra se doori hai. Dharti ki satah se neeche khadaan (mine) me jaane par aapke upar wali mitti ka hissa kaam karta hai aur andar ke hisse ka gravitation cancel ho jata hai - isliye g ghatti hai. Satah se upar (pahad ya vimaan ki unchai) jaane par doori R badh jaati hai, isliye g wahan bhi ghatti hai. Yaani dono taraf g badhti nahi, ghatti hai. Exam point: 'Neeche (mine) aur upar (atmosphere) dono me g ghatti hai'.

qe: What is the theoretical value of acceleration due to gravity (g) at the absolute center of the Earth?
qh: पृथ्वी के बिल्कुल केंद्र (Center of Earth) पर गुरुत्वीय त्वरण (g) का मान कितना होता है?
o: Zero
Infinite
e: Concept: Dharti ko ek thaali (shell) jaisa maan lein jo kendron ke around gol hai. Gauss ke the m, kisi gol ke andar wale bindu par bahar ke hisse ka gravitation static bhi nahi hota aur andar ke saare hisson ka force cancel ho jata hai. Bilkul kendra (centre) par dharti ka poora mass chaaron taraf barabar fails jata hai, isliye net force ZERO hota hai. Isliye kendra par g = 0 hota hai (kuch log sochte hain infinite). Exam point: 'Dharti ke kendra par g = zero'.

qe: If an object has a mass of 60 kg on Earth, what will be its mass and weight on the Moon? (Assume g_earth = 10 m/s^2)
qh: यदि किसी वस्तु का द्रव्यमान पृथ्वी पर 60 kg है, तो चंद्रमा की सतह पर उसका द्रव्यमान और भार क्रमशः कितना होगा? (g_earth = 10 m/s^2)
o: 60 kg and 600 N
10 kg and 100 N
60 kg and 100 N
10 kg and 600 N
e: Concept: Weight W = mass * g hota hai. Mass ek jagah se doosri jagah NAHI badalta, isliye chand par bhi mass 60 kg hi rahega. Chand par g lagbhag 1.67 m/s^2 hoti hai, isliye weight = 60 * 1.67 = 100 N (lagbhag). Dharti par isi vastu ka weight 60 * 10 = 600 N hota. Isliye ek hi mass ka weight Earth aur Moon par alag hota hai. Exam point: 'Mass sab jagah same; Moon par weight lagbhag 1/6 ho jata hai'. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Yahi sahi uttar 60 kg and 100 N hai. Is vishay ke ulte prashn bhi poochhe jaate hain, isliye dono taraf ka tathya saaf karna zaroori hai.

qe: If a heavy iron hammer and a light bird feather are dropped simultaneously in a complete vacuum chamber, what will be observed?
qh: यदि एक भारी लोहे के हथौड़े और हल्के पंख को पूर्ण निर्वात (vacuum) में समान ऊंचाई से छोड़ा जाए, तो क्या होगा?
o: The hammer will reach the bottom first because it is heavier
Both will reach the bottom at the exact same time
The feather will float upwards due to buoyancy
Both will stop moving in vacuum
e: Concept: Normal hawa me patla kagaz dheere girta hai kyunki air resistance use rokta hai; par vacuum (khaali jagah) me hawa hi nahi hoti, isliye koi resistance nahi hota. Garaj (gravitation) sabhi vastuon ko ek hi acceleration g (9.8 m/s^2) deti hai - chahe wo bhaari hathoda ho ya halka paankh. Isliye vacuum me dono ek saath neeche pahunchte hain (Apollo 15 me chand par fekar ye experiment dikhaya gaya tha). Exam point: 'Vacuum me sab vastu same speed se girte hain (g independent of mass)'.

qe: Why does a flat sheet of paper fall slower than the same paper crumpled into a tight ball in a normal room with air?
qh: हवा वाले कमरे में कागज की समतल शीट उसी कागज की मोड़ी हुई गेंद की तुलना में धीमी क्यों गिरती है?
o: Because the crumpled ball gains extra gravitational force
Because flat shapes are repelled by magnetic forces
Because the flat sheet has a larger surface area and experiences greater air resistance
Because crumpling increases the mass of the paper
e: Concept: Kagaz ke patte (ki sheet) ka surface area bada hota hai, isliye niche girte waqt use hawa ka bahut zyada pratirodh (air resistance/drag) lagta hai - jo uski gati ko kaafi kam kar deta hai. Wahi kagaz jab tight ball ban jata hai, to uska area bahut kam ho jata hai, isliye air resistance kam lagta hai aur wo tez girta hai. Isse saabit hota hai ki g sab par same hai; sirf hawa ka asar area par nirbhar karta hai. Exam point: 'Flat paper dheere girta hai = bada area = zyada air resistance'.

qe: In physics, what is the core distinction between 'Thrust' and 'Pressure'?
qh: भौतिकी में 'प्रणोद' (Thrust) और 'दाब' (Pressure) के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?
o: Both measure identical parameters with the same units
Thrust is scalar and Pressure is vector
Pressure does not depend on contact surface area
Thrust is the total perpendicular force acting on a surface, while Pressure is thrust per unit area (P = F/A)
e: Concept: 'Thrust' wo poora force batata hai jo kisi satah par uske lambavat (perpendicular) lagta hai (unit newton); alag-alag angle par lagne wale force ka sirf lambavat hissa thrust kehlata hai. 'Pressure' = thrust / area (P = F/A) hota hai - matlab ek hi force chhote area par zyada pressure deta hai. Isliye pressure ka unit N/m^2 (pascal) hai jo thrust se alag hai. Dono scalar hain; area ka pressure par seedha asar hota hai. Exam point: 'Thrust = total force; Pressure = thrust per unit area (P = F/A)'.

qe: Why does a person sink deep into loose sand while standing on feet, but does not sink much when lying down?
qh: रेत पर पैरों के बल खड़े होने पर व्यक्ति उसमें धंस जाता है, लेकिन लेटने पर नहीं धंसता। क्यों?
o: Because loose sand absorbs horizontal force only
Because body mass decreases when lying down
Because gravity decreases in a horizontal posture
Because standing concentrates weight on a smaller area creating higher pressure (P = F/A)
e: Concept: Admi khade hone par uske pairon ka area bahut chhota hota hai, isliye pura wajan (thrust) chhote area par padta hai aur pressure P = F/A bahut zyada banta hai - isliye pair ret (sand) me dhas jaate hain. Letne (lying) par pura sharir satah par fail jata hai, area bahut badh jata hai, isliye pressure kam ho jata hai aur admi kam dhas ta hai. Yahan mass ya gravity nahi badalte, sirf 'area' badalta hai - yahi P = F/A ka asar hai. Exam point: 'Chhota area = zyada pressure (khade hone par ret me dhansna)'.

qe: Why are cutting tools like knives, needles, and nails manufactured with extremely sharp edges or pointed ends?
qh: चाकू, सुई और कील को अत्यंत नुकीला या धारदार क्यों बनाया जाता है?
o: To reduce the contact area so that a small force generates very high pressure (P = F/A)
To change the chemical properties of materials
To maximize the contact area
To absorb internal mechanical stress
e: Concept: Pressure ka formula P = F/A hai. Agar contact area (A) bahut chhota kar diya jaye, to usi chhote force F se bhi bahut bada pressure paida hota hai - isliye chaku ki dhaar, sui ki nok aur keel ke sire ko bahut tez (pointed) banate hain. Isi tarah motor gaari ke 'pin' nok wale hote hain taaki kam force me bhi dhas jaye. Area maximize karne se pressure kam hota (joote ki sole, trekking shoes) - ye ulta concept hai. Exam point: 'Sharp edge = chhota area = zyada pressure (kam force me kaam)'.

qe: How does the hydrostatic pressure inside a static liquid fundamentally vary with depth?
qh: एक स्थिर द्रव के भीतर द्रवस्थैतिक दाब गहराई के साथ किस प्रकार बदलता है?
o: It remains constant regardless of depth
It drops to zero at the bottom center
It decreases continuously with depth
It increases continuously with depth due to the increasing weight of the liquid column above (P = rho*g*h)
e: Concept: Drav (liquid) ke andar pressure uske Upar wale column ke wazan se aata hai: P = rho * g * h, jahan rho density, g gravity aur h depth hai. Jaise-jaise gehrai (h) badhti hai, upar wale drav ka column bhaari hota jata hai - isliye pressure bhi lagatar BADHTA jata hai. Isi wajah se band (dam) ki deewar niche moti banai jaati hai aur gehre samudra me pressure itna zyada hota hai. Exam point: 'Gehrai badhne par hydrostatic pressure badhta hai (P = rho g h)'.

qe: What did Archimedes' Principle discover regarding the magnitude of buoyant force (upthrust) acting on a submerged body?
qh: आर्कमीडीज के सिद्धांत के अनुसार किसी डूबे हुए पिंड पर लगने वाले उत्प्लावन बल का मान किसके बराबर होता है?
o: It depends solely on the color of the liquid
It is always zero inside closed vessels
It is equal to the total mass of the object
It is equal to the weight of the fluid displaced by the immersed body
e: Concept: Archimedes ka sidhant: jab koi vastu drav (fluid) me poori ya aadhi dubi rehti hai, to use Opar ki taraf ek dhakka (buoyant force/upthrust) milta hai. Us dhakke ka magnitude bilkul us drav ke wazan ke barabar hota hai jo vastu ne hata diya (displaced kiya). Isliye nasht vastu ka volume jitna paani hatega, utna upthrust milega. Yad rahe: upward thrust = displaced fluid ka weight, vastu ke mass ya rang se iska koi matlab nahi. Exam point: 'Buoyant force = hata diye gaye drav ka bhaar (Archimedes)'.

qe: Why is it much easier for a human to float and swim in sea water compared to fresh river water?
qh: ताजे नदी के पानी की तुलना में समुद्र के खारे पानी में तैरना आसान क्यों होता है?
o: Because sea waves push the swimmer forward
Because salt reduces human body mass
Because sea water contains dissolved salts making it denser, exerting a greater buoyant upthrust
Because sea water has zero gravity
e: Concept: Samudra ke paani me namak (salt) ghula hota hai, isliye uski density nadi ke mithay paani se zyada hoti hai (lagbhag 1.03 vs 1.0 g/cm3). Buoyant upthrust displaced fluid ke weight par nirbhar karta hai, isliye ghana samudri paani zyada upthrust deta hai aur adam aasani se tair leta hai. Isi kaaran Dead Sea me tairna aur bhi aasan hai (wahan namak bahut zyada hai). Samundri lehren aage push karti hain - iska upthrust se koi lena-dena nahi. Exam point: 'Samudra ka paani ghana = zyada upthrust = tairna aasan'.

qe: An iron nail sinks immediately in water, but a massive ship made of iron floats effortlessly. Why?
qh: लोहे की कील पानी में डूब जाती है, लेकिन लोहे का बना विशाल जहाज तैरता है। क्यों?
o: Because the ship travels faster than the nail
Because the ship is hollow and encloses air, displacing a weight of water equal to its total weight
Because water molecules attract nails more than ships
Because the ship alters the mass of iron
e: Concept: Loha ka ghanatv paani se zyada hota hai, isliye thos keelake jaisa loha doob jata hai. Lekin jahaj ko khaali (hollow) banate hain aur uske andar hawa bhari jati hai - isse jahaj ka average density paani se kam ho jati hai aur wo itna paani (volume) hata deta hai jiska WAZAN uske poore wazan ke barabar hota hai. Archimedes ke sidhant se upthrust = displaced water ka wazan hone ke kaaran jahaj tairta rehta hai. Exam point: 'Jahaj isliye tairta hai kyunki khaali (air-filled) hokar bahut paani hata deta hai'.

qe: What is the primary scientific criterion that determines whether a solid object will float or sink in a fluid?
qh: यह तय करने का मुख्य वैज्ञानिक नियम क्या है कि कोई ठोस वस्तु द्रव में तैरेगी या डूबेगी?
o: The depth of the liquid container
The total mass of the object alone
Comparison of the object's density with the fluid's density
The shape and color profile of the object
e: Concept: Koi bhi padaarth drav me tair-ega ya doobega, ye uske Ghanatv (density = mass/volume) par nirbhar karta hai. Agar vastu ki density drav se kam hai to wo tair-egi (ice in water), barabar hai to latki rahegi, aur zyada hai to doobegi (loha in water). Vastu ka shape, rang ya container ki gehrai is faisle par asar nahi karti - sirf density ka comparison matter karta hai. Exam point: 'Float/sink = vastu ki density vs drav ki density'.

qe: An object whose density is exactly equal to the density of the liquid is placed completely inside that liquid. What will happen to it?
qh: यदि किसी वस्तु का घनत्व द्रव के घनत्व के ठीक बराबर हो और उसे द्रव में डुबोया जाए, तो क्या होगा?
o: It will remain suspended at whatever depth it is placed within the liquid
It will sink to the bottom immediately
It will start spinning at high speed
It will pop out of the liquid surface
e: Concept: Archimedes ke sidhant ke hisaab se upthrust us drav ke WAZAN ke barabar hota hai jo vidhu ne hata diya. Agar vastu ki density drav ki density ke bilkul BARABAR ho, to upthrust vastu ke poore wazan ko theek sambhal leta hai - na zyada, na kam. Isliye vastu kahin bhi (kisi bhi gehrai par) apni jagah tik kar latki (suspend) rehti hai; na doobti na oopar aati. Ye density comparison wali rule ka khaas kase hai. Exam point: 'Density barabbar = vastu drav me latki rehti hai (suspend)'.

qe: Under what strict kinematic condition are average speed and the magnitude of average velocity completely identical?
qh: किस गतिज स्थिति में औसत चाल और औसत वेग का परिमाण बिल्कुल समान होता है?
o: When acceleration is permanently perpendicular to velocity
When the object moves in a uniform circular loop
When total displacement at the end of the trip is zero
When the object moves strictly in a straight line without changing its direction
e: Concept: 'Average speed' = total path length / total time hota hai (scalar). 'Average velocity' ka magnitude = net displacement / total time. Path length aur displacement tab hi barabar hote hain jab vastu bilkul seedhi line me bina disha badle chale - kyunki tab har kadam disha me hi hota hai. Circular ya mudte-mudte raaste me displacement chhota (ya vakra) hota hai, isliye dono alag ho jate hain. Exam point: 'Speed = velocity tab jab straight line me bina direction badle chale'.

qe: Why does instantaneous speed always equal the magnitude of instantaneous velocity at any precise moment?
qh: किसी विशिष्ट क्षण पर तात्कालिक चाल का मान तात्कालिक वेग के परिमाण के ठीक बराबर क्यों होता है?
o: Because over an infinitesimally small time interval (delta_t -> 0), the object cannot change direction, making path length equal displacement
Because acceleration drops to zero instantaneously
Because instantaneous speed is a vector quantity
Because path length contracts in motion
e: Concept: Jab samay ka antaraal bahut chhota (delta t lagbhag zero) ho jaye, to utne chhote samay me vastu ki disha badalne ka mauka hi nahi hota - us pal ka chhota-sa path bhi lagbhag seedhi line hi hota hai. Isliye ek akshan (instant) par path length = displacement ka magnitude, aur isliye instantaneous speed = |instantaneous velocity|. Ye property sirf 'instant' ke liye sach hai, average ke liye nahi. Exam point: 'Instant par speed = velocity ka magnitude (kyunki delta t -> 0)'.

qe: What physical quantity is represented by the slope of a Distance-Time Graph?
qh: दूरी-समय ग्राफ की ढाल (Slope) क्या प्रदर्शित करती है?
o: Force
Displacement
Speed
Acceleration
e: Concept: Distance-time graph me x-aksh par samay aur y-aksh par doori hoti hai. Slope = (doori me badlav)/(samay me badlav) = speed. Isliye jitni tezi se graph chadhta hai (steep), utni zyada speed. Force, displacement ya acceleration graph ke slope se nahi milte - wo doosre concepts hain. Exam me seedha 'dt graph ka slope = speed' yaad rakho. Exam point: 'Distance-Time graph ka slope = speed'. Isliye in vikalpon ko chhod dena chahiye. Isliye sahi uttar Speed hi hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: If a distance-time graph is a straight line parallel to the time axis, what does it signify?
qh: यदि दूरी-समय ग्राफ समय अक्ष के समानांतर एक क्षैतिज रेखा है, तो इसका क्या अर्थ है?
o: The object is at rest
The object is moving with constant acceleration
The object is moving with infinite speed
The object is in circular motion
e: Concept: Agar distance-time graph ek seedhi rekha hai jo time-axis ke SAMANTAR (horizontal) chalti hai, to y-aksh (doori) me koi badlav nahi ho raha - samay bit raha hai par doori wahi ki wahi hai. Matlab vastu apni jagah pe hi khadi hai - 'at rest'. Infinite speed ka matlab hota graph uchhal (vertical) jaye; constant acceleration wala case distance-time graph me curve deta hai. Exam point: 'Distance-Time graph horizontal = vastu viraam (rest) me hai'.

qe: What physical quantity is determined by the slope of a Velocity-Time Graph?
qh: वेग-समय ग्राफ की ढाल (Slope) से हमें कौन सी राशि प्राप्त होती है?
o: Speed
Acceleration
Impulse
Displacement
e: Concept: Velocity-time graph me y-aksh par velocity hoti hai aur x-aksh par samay. Slope = (velocity me badlav)/(samay) = acceleration. Isliye graph jitna tez chadhta ya girta hai, utni zyada acceleration. Zero slope (horizontal line) ka matlab uniform velocity (acceleration zero). Exam point: 'Velocity-Time graph ka slope = acceleration'. Yah vikalp anya sandarbh se aa jaate hain. Isliye sahi uttar Acceleration hi hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: What physical quantity is represented by the total area enclosed under a Velocity-Time graph?
qh: वेग-समय ग्राफ के नीचे का कुल क्षेत्रफल क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Instantaneous acceleration
Rate of change of momentum
Displacement or Distance traveled
Average speed squared
e: Concept: Velocity-time graph ke neeche ka area nikalne ka matlab hai 'velocity * samay', jo displacement ke barabar hota hai (kyunki displacement = mean velocity * time). Isi kaaran agar graph curve ho to area alag-alag chhote rectangles/trapeziums me todkar jodte hain. Average speed squared ya momentum rate ka isse koi sambandh nahi - area hamesha distance ya displacement deta hai. Exam point: 'v-t graph ke neeche ka area = doori (displacement)'.

qe: Why are the standard equations of motion (v = u + at, s = ut + 1/2at^2) inapplicable to uniform circular motion?
qh: गति के मानक समीकरण एकसमान वृत्तीय गति पर लागू क्यों नहीं होते हैं?
o: Because speed is variable
Because circular motion occurs only in vacuum
Because acceleration magnitude is changing
Because in circular motion, the direction of acceleration continuously changes, violating the constant vector requirement
e: Concept: Gati ke samikaran (equations of motion) sirf tab lagte hain jab acceleration CONSTANT ho - matlab uski magnitude aur DISHA dono fixed ho. Uniform circular motion me chaal constant rehti hai par acceleration ki DISHA har pal badalti rehti hai (hamesha kendra ki taraf), isliye ye samikaran vahan nahi lag sakte. Speed variable na hone par bhi ye equations fail hoti hain kyunki direction badal raha hai. Exam point: 'Circular motion me acceleration ki direction badalti hai, isliye equations of motion lagu nahi'.

qe: Besides having both magnitude and direction, what third mandatory mathematical condition must a physical quantity satisfy to be a vector?
qh: परिमाण और दिशा के अलावा, किसी राशि को सदिश होने के लिए कौन सी तीसरी अनिवार्य शर्त पूरी करनी होती है?
o: It must be independent of measurement units
It must be conserved in all collisions
It must remain positive in all reference frames
It must obey the Triangle Law or Parallelogram Law of vector addition
e: Concept: Vector sirf wo nahi jo magnitude aur direction rakhta ho - usko vector addition ke niyam bhi follow karne padte hain: triangle law ya parallelogram law. Ye do niyam batate hain ki do vectors ko kaise jodkar resultant nikala jaye. Temperature, energy jaisi cheezein direction ke saath bhi vector nahi hoti kyunki unka addition aisa nahi hota. Exam point: 'Vector = magnitude + direction + triangle/parallelogram law ka palan'.

qe: When a projectile is launched into the air at an angle theta to the horizontal, what happens to its horizontal velocity component during flight (ignoring air drag)?
qh: प्रक्षेप्य गति में उड़ान के दौरान क्षैतिज वेग घटक (Horizontal Velocity) पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
o: It continuously drops to zero at the peak
It remains completely constant throughout the flight
It increases due to gravity
It reverses direction symmetrically
e: Concept: Projectile me hawa ka resistance na ho to horizontal direction me koi force nahi lagta (gravity sirf niche ki taraf lagti hai). Isliye horizontal velocity ka koi aksh (component) badalne ka kaaran nahi - wo shuru se aakhir tak bilkul constant rehta hai (v0 cos theta). Sirf vertical component upar jaate hue ghatta hai aur niche aate hue badhta hai. Exam point: 'Projectile ki horizontal velocity constant; vertical velocity badalti hai'.

qe: At the highest point (apex) of a projectile's trajectory, what are the values of its velocity and acceleration?
qh: प्रक्षेप्य के उच्चतम बिंदु पर इसके वेग और त्वरण का मान क्या होता है?
o: Velocity is horizontal (v0 cos theta) and acceleration is downward (g)
Velocity is zero and acceleration is g
Both velocity and acceleration are zero
Velocity is vertical and acceleration is zero
e: Concept: Projectile ke sabse unche bindu (apex) par uska vertical velocity lagbhag ZERO ho jata hai (kyunki wo upar se niche mudne wala hai), par horizontal velocity (v0 cos theta) abhi bhi maujood rehti hai - isliye apex par net velocity horizontal hoti hai. Gravity hamesha kaam karti hai, isliye acceleration wahan bhi 'g' hi hoti hai, niche ki taraf (hawa ke bina). Isliye apex par velocity horizontal + acceleration g downward - dono saath. Exam point: 'Apex par: velocity horizontal, acceleration g (downward)'.

qe: At what launch angle theta does a projectile achieve its absolute maximum horizontal range for a given initial speed?
qh: किसी निश्चित प्रारंभिक गति के लिए प्रक्षेप्य का क्षैतिज परास किस प्रक्षेप कोण पर अधिकतम होता है?
o: 45 degrees
60 degrees
90 degrees
30 degrees
e: Concept: Projectile ki range ka formula R = v^2 * sin(2*theta) / g hota hai. Isme sin(2*theta) ki value maximum 1 hoti hai jab 2*theta = 90 degree, yaani theta = 45 degree. Isliye 45 degree par sabse door tak projectile jaata hai. Kuch aur angle (jaise 30 ya 60) par sin(2theta) ki value kam ho jaati hai, isliye range kam hoti hai; 90 degree par to seedha upar hi jayega. Exam point: 'Maximum range = 45 degree launch angle par'.

qe: Newton's first law of motion equates a body at rest with a body in uniform linear motion. What parameter is zero in both states?
qh: न्यूटन का पहला नियम विराम अवस्था और एकसमान रेखीय गति को समतुल्य मानता है। दोनों अवस्थाओं में क्या शून्य होता है?
o: Total kinetic energy
Linear momentum
Net external force (and therefore acceleration)
Instantaneous velocity
e: Concept: Newton ka pehla niyam kehta hai ki agar kisi vastu par koi net bahari force na lage, to wo apni halat nahi badalti - ya to viraam (rest) me rahegi ya ek seedhi line me ek jaisi chaal (uniform velocity) se chalti rahegi. Dono halaton me common baat: net external force = zero, aur isliye accelerator bhi zero. Velocity zero nahi hoti (moving body ki velocity to hai), kinetic energy bhi zero nahi hoti. Exam point: 'Rest + uniform motion dono me net external force zero'.

qe: A seasoned cricketer draws his hands backward while catching a fast cricket ball. What is the scientific purpose of this technique?
qh: क्रिकेटर कैच पकड़ते समय अपने हाथों को पीछे क्यों खींचता है?
o: To decrease the ball's mass
To prevent the ball from bouncing due to gravity
To increase the impact time duration, thereby reducing the rate of change of momentum and impact force
To maintain zero momentum throughout
e: Concept: Cricket ball ko pakadte waqt hands ko peeche kheenchna galti nahi, takneek hai. Iska kaam hai 'impact time' (ball ke rukne ka samay) ko badhana. Impulse = force * time = momentum me badlav, aur momentum ka badlav fixed hota hai - isliye samay (t) badha dene par force (F) kam ho jata hai (F = delta p / t). Isi liye haath peeche khinchkar pakadne par chot kam lagti hai. Ball ka mass nahi badalta. Exam point: 'Hands peeche kheencho = time badhao = force kam karo (impulse)'.

qe: A passenger standing in a stationary bus falls backward when the bus suddenly accelerates forward. This experience is explained by:
qh: स्थिर बस के अचानक चलने पर खड़ा यात्री पीछे की ओर गिरता है। इसका कारण क्या है?
o: Action-reaction cancellation
Sudden increase in body weight
Gravitational attraction of the rear engine
Inertia of rest of the upper body
e: Concept: Jab bus achanak aage chalti hai, to bus ke saath-saath admi ke PAON aage badh jate hain, par uska upari sharir (sar, dhad) purane sthaan par hi viraam (rest) me rehna chahta hai - isi ko 'inertia of rest' kehte hain. Isi kaaran admi Peechhe girta hai. Ulta case: chalte hue bus ke achanak rokne par admi aage girta hai (inertia of motion). Ye Newton ka pehla niyam (inertia) ka roz ka udaharan hai. Exam point: 'Bus chalne par peeche girna = inertia of rest'.

qe: Why do action and reaction forces mentioned in Newton's Third Law never cancel each other out?
qh: न्यूटन के तीसरे नियम के क्रिया और प्रतिक्रिया बल एक-दूसरे को कभी निरस्त क्यों नहीं करते?
o: Because one is real and the other is imaginary
Because they act on two different bodies simultaneously
Because they are not equal in magnitude
Because they act at different times
e: Concept: Newton ka teesra niyam kehta hai action aur reaction barabar aur ulte hote hain. Par ye dono forces ALAG-ALAG vastuon par lagte hain - jaise aap deewar ko dhakeltein hain (deewar par force) aur deewar aapko dhakelti hai (aap par force). Ek hi vastu par nahi lagne ke kaaran se ye ek doosre ko cancel nahi karte; isliye kesi bhi sanshy me dono ki magnitude barabar rehne par bhi motion ho jaati hai. Exam point: 'Action-reaction cancel nahi hote kyunki wo alag-alag bodies par lagte hain'.

qe: All macro-mechanical contact forces such as friction, normal reaction, and tension in a string microscopically originate from:
qh: घर्षण, अभिलंब बल और तनाव जैसे संपर्क बल सूक्ष्म स्तर पर किस मूल बल से उत्पन्न होते हैं?
o: Strong nuclear forces
Gravitational forces
Weak decay interactions
Electromagnetic forces between atomic electrons and nuclei
e: Concept: Roz marra ke sampark bal (contact forces) - friction (ghisav), normal reaction (satah ka dhakka), tension (rassi ka khinchav) - asal me kya hain? Ye sab parmanuon ke electron aur nucleus ke beech lagne wale vidyut-chumbakiya (electromagnetic) balon ka net parinaam hain. Jab do satahen pass aati hain to electron clouds ek doosre ko dhakelte hain - yahi makroskopik bal ban jata hai. Strong/weak nuclear force sirf nucleus ke andar kaam karta hai. Exam point: 'Contact forces ka mool kaaran = electromagnetic force'.

qe: How does the limiting value of static friction (f_s_max) depend on the macroscopic area of contact between two dry surfaces?
qh: स्थैतिक घर्षण का अधिकतम मान (सीमांत घर्षण) संपर्क क्षेत्रफल पर किस प्रकार निर्भर करता है?
o: Directly proportional to contact area
Independent of the macroscopic contact area
Inversely proportional to contact area
Proportional to area squared
e: Concept: Sthir gharsh (static friction) ka maximum value f_s_max = mu_s * N hota hai, jahan N normal reaction hai. N bahut kam had tak contact area par nirbhar karta hai (sateh ke actual micro-sampark ka asar alag baat hai), isliye AAM macroscopic area ghatane-badhaane se f_s_max nahi badalta - ye asal me independent hota hai. Isi wajah se choti/badi sole wali chappal ka friction lagbhag same rehta hai (jab tak material same hai). Exam point: 'Static friction ka max value macroscopic contact area par nirbhar nahi'.

qe: When an object starts sliding relative to a surface, what happens to the frictional force at the interface?
qh: जब कोई वस्तु फिसलने लगती है, तो घर्षण बल पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
o: It drops slightly from maximum static friction to a nearly constant kinetic friction (f_k < f_s_max)
It points perpendicular to the surface
It increases exponentially with speed
It immediately drops to absolute zero
e: Concept: Jab koi vastu satah par sarkna (slide) shuru karti hai, to gharsh bal (friction) thoda kam ho jata hai. Iska kaaran ye hai ki sliding ke dauran satahon ke chhote-sateh jod tut-te rehte hain (isliye jitna static me bandhne ka mauka deta hai, utna kinetic me nahi milta). Isliye kinetic friction f_k < f_s_max hota hai, par ye kisi bhi speed ke saath badhta nahi - lagbhag constant rehta hai. Exam point: 'Sliding shuru hone par: f_k < f_s(max), lagbhag constant'.

qe: What physical force provides the necessary centripetal force for a car making a turn on a flat, unbanked circular road?
qh: समतल क्षैतिज सड़क पर मोड़ लेते समय कार को आवश्यक अभिकेंद्र बल कौन प्रदान करता है?
o: The downward weight of the vehicle
Static friction between the tyres and the road surface
The normal reaction from the road
The air drag against the windshield
e: Concept: Gaari jab samtal (flat) sadak par mod (turn) leti hai, to use kendra ki taraf centripetal force chahiye. Samtal sadak par iski koi bahari jhukav nahi hoti, isliye ye force TYRE aur sadak ke beech ka sthir gharsh (static friction) hi deta hai - jo tyre ko kisne se rokta hai aur gaari mudti hai. Agar sadak ice jaisi slippery ho to friction nahi milega aur gaari seedhi fisal jayegi. Weight aur normal reaction vertical hain, woh centripetal nahi de sakte. Exam point: 'Flat road par turn ka centripetal force = static friction (tyre-road)'.

qe: The maximum safe speed for a car negotiating a curve of radius R on a level road with friction coefficient mu_s is v_max = sqrt(mu_s * R * g). What does this imply about vehicle mass?
qh: समतल मोड़ पर सुरक्षित गति $v = \sqrt{\mu_s R g}$ से कार के द्रव्यमान के बारे में क्या निष्कर्ष निकलता है?
o: Heavy trucks can turn faster than light cars
Light cars can turn faster than trucks
Maximum safe speed is completely independent of the vehicle's mass
Safe speed is directly proportional to mass
e: Concept: Safe speed ka formula v_max = sqrt(mu_s * R * g) hota hai - isme vehicle ka MASS nahi aata! Isliye is curve par koi bhi gaari (hal ki car ya bhaari truck) ek hi maximum speed tak safely mud sakti hai. Ye samajhna zaroori hai kyunki sab sochte hain bhaari gaari dheere mudegi - asal me farq sirf friction (tyre), curve ka radius aur g se padta hai. Heavy trucks aksar high centre of gravity ke kaaran palat jate hain - wo alag concept hai. Exam point: 'v_max mass par nirbhar nahi (mu_s, R, g par nirbhar)'.

qe: Why can a fluid at rest not sustain any shear stress?
qh: विराम अवस्था में कोई तरल अपरूपण प्रतिबल (Shear Stress) क्यों सहन नहीं कर सकता?
o: Because fluids do not have mass
Because fluid density drops to zero under shear
Because it would flow immediately under any non-zero tangential force
Because atmospheric pressure cancels all fluid forces
e: Concept: 'Shear stress' (kapoti tanav) wo hota hai jab kisi satah ke along tangentially (sparshatmak) khinchav lagaya jaye. Fluid (drav) ki khaas baat hai ki wo apni shakal aasani se badal deta hai - agar us par thoda-sa bhi tan-janya force lagaya jaye to uski paraton me sliding shuru ho jaati hai aur wo behne lagta hai. Isliye viraam (rest) me pada drav kisi bhi shear stress ko sah nahi kar sakta. Solids shear stress ko sambhal sakte hain, fluids nahi. Exam point: 'Fluid viraam me shear stress nahi sambhal sakta - turant behta hai'.

qe: Pascal's law for a fluid at rest states that pressure is identical at all points that are:
qh: पास्कल के नियम के अनुसार एक स्थिर द्रव के भीतर दाब उन सभी बिंदुओं पर समान होता है जो:
o: In contact with the atmosphere
Located at the exact same horizontal level
Aligned vertically along the gravity axis
Near the center of the vessel only
e: Concept: Pascal ka niyam viraam (rest) me pade drav ke liye kehta hai ki ek hi horizontal (samtal) level par harek bindu par pressure ek jaisa hota hai - kyunki usi level ke neeche wali drav ki unchai (depth) same hoti hai. Isi wajah se paani ke auro me (jinke aakar alag hain) ek hi unchai ke saare binduon par pressure same hota hai. Iske alawa kisi bhi band bindu par lagaya gaya pressure poore drav me barabar fail jata hai (hydraulic press ka aadhaar). Exam point: 'Same horizontal level = same pressure (Pascal ka niyam)'.

qe: The 'Hydrostatic Paradox' shows that three vessels of different shapes filled with water to the same height have the same base pressure. This happens because:
qh: अलग-अलग आकार के बर्तनों में समान ऊंचाई तक पानी भरने पर तली पर दाब समान होता है। क्यों?
o: Water changes its density with shape
Atmospheric pressure becomes zero
Surface tension pulls all vessels equally
Liquid pressure at the base depends strictly on fluid column height and density, not on vessel shape (P = rho*g*h)
e: Concept: 'Hydrostatic Paradox' ek dilchasp ghatna hai: alag-alag shakal ke bartan (patla, chaura, tircha) ek hi unchai (height) tak paani se bharein, to sabke tal par pressure barabar hoga - chahe paani ki maatra alag ho. Iska raaz hai formula P = rho * g * h: pressure sirf drav ki unchai aur density par nirbhar karta hai, bartan ke aakar (shape) par nahi. Isliye koi bhi aakaar ho, saman unchai = saman base pressure. Exam point: 'P = rho g h - base pressure shape par nirbhar nahi (hydrostatic paradox)'.

qe: The Equation of Continuity (A1 * v1 = A2 * v2) in fluid dynamics is a mathematical statement of which conservation law?
qh: तरल प्रवाह में सांतत्य समीकरण ($A_1 v_1 = A_2 v_2$) किस संरक्षण नियम का गणितीय रूप है?
o: Conservation of Energy
Conservation of Mass
Conservation of Linear Momentum
Conservation of Angular Momentum
e: Concept: 'Equation of Continuity' kehta hai ki ek hi nali me guzarne wale drav ke liye A1 * v1 = A2 * v2 hona chahiye - matlab jahan nali patli (A kam) wahan speed (v) zyada, aur jahan moti wahan kam. Iska mool aadhaar ye hai ki drav na kahin banta hai na khatam hota hai (incompressible flow me) - jo andar ja raha hai wo bahar aana hi hai, isliye ye asal me Mass ka sanrakshan hai. Energy ka niyam Bernoulli me aata hai. Exam point: 'A1v1 = A2v2 = mass conservation (continuity)'.

qe: According to Bernoulli's principle and continuity, how does an airplane wing (aerofoil) generate upward dynamic lift?
qh: हवाई जहाज का पंख (Aerofoil) ऊपर की ओर लिफ्ट कैसे उत्पन्न करता है?
o: By ejecting compressed air downward
By blocking Earth's gravity photons
By heating the air below the wing
By causing air streamlines to crowd together on top, creating higher speed and lower pressure above the wing than below it
e: Concept: Aeroplane ka pankh (aerofoil) aisa bana hota hai ki upar ki satah thodi ubhari hoti hai. Hawa upar ke raaste me patli jagah se guzarti hai, isliye streamlines wahan kareeb-kareeb (crowd) ho jaati hain, hawa ki speed badh jaati hai. Bernoulli ke siddhant se jahan speed zyada wahan pressure kam hota hai - isliye pankh ke upar kam pressure aur neeche zyada pressurebanta hai, aur ye pressure ka farq pankh ko upar dhakel deta hai (dynamic lift). Exam point: 'Lift = upar speed zyada = pressure kam (Bernoulli)'.

qe: According to Stokes' Law, the viscous drag force F acting on a spherical object of radius 'a' moving with speed 'v' in a fluid of viscosity 'eta' is:
qh: स्टोक्स के नियम के अनुसार श्यान माध्यम में गतिमान गोले पर लगने वाला श्यान बल क्या होता है?
o: F = 4/3 * pi * eta * a^2
F = 6 * pi * eta * a * v
F = eta * a / v
F = 2 * pi * eta * a * v^2
e: Concept: Stokes' law ballnay shakal (spherical object) ke liye viscous drag (gharsh bal) ka formula deta hai: F = 6 * pi * eta * a * v, jahan eta drav ki viscosity (ghunchapan), a gola ka radius aur v uski speed hai. Iska matlab: jitna bada (radius), utni zyada speed, utna zyada drag force lagta hai. Ye formula viscosity naapne ke experiments me bahut kaam aata hai. Samanya se 6*pi ko miss na karo - a^2 ya v^2 wale options galat hain. Exam point: 'Stokes law: F = 6 pi eta a v'.

qe: When a falling raindrop achieves its constant 'terminal velocity', the net force acting on it is:
qh: जब गिरती हुई बारिश की बूंद अपना 'सीमांत वेग' (Terminal Velocity) प्राप्त कर लेती है, तो उस पर कुल बल कितना होता है?
o: Equal to its weight
Zero, because upward viscous drag plus buoyancy balances downward gravity
Dependent on wind direction
Infinite
e: Concept: Barish ki boond girti hai to shuru me uski speed badhti hai, par jaise speed badhti hai viscous drag (Stokes force) bhi badhta hai. Ek khaas speed par drag + upthrust mil kar boond ke wazan ko theek balance kar deta hai - iske baad net force ZERO ho jata hai. Isliye acceleration zero ho jaati hai aur boond constant speed se girti rehti hai - isi speedko 'terminal velocity' kehte hain. Zero net force ka matlab rukna nahi, bas speed na badalna hai. Exam point: 'Terminal velocity par net force = zero (drag+buoyancy = weight)'.

qe: Why do free liquid drops and soap bubbles naturally assume a spherical shape in the absence of gravity?
qh: गुरुत्वाकर्षण की अनुपस्थिति में द्रव की बूंदें और साबुन के बुलबुले गोलाकार क्यों होते हैं?
o: Because viscosity forces circular motion
Because water molecules repel air
Because a sphere has the least surface area for a given volume, minimizing surface potential energy
Because atmospheric pressure compresses them into spheres
e: Concept: Drav ki boond (ya sabun ka bubbles) ke andar aur bahar ke molekul ek doosre ko kheenchte hain, isliye surface par ek 'khinchav' (surface tension) banta hai. Har system aisi halat me jaana chahta hai jisme uski surface energy kam se kam ho - aur kisi diye gaye volume ke liye SAABSE KAM surface area gol (sphere) ka hi hota hai (matematik ka niyam). Isliye hawa me tairti boond aur bubbles gol shakal me ho jaate hain. Exam point: 'Boond/bubble gol isliye = diye volume ke liye sphere ka area sabse kam'.

qe: How does the excess pressure inside a spherical soap bubble compare to that inside a liquid drop of the same radius r?
qh: समान त्रिज्या r के साबुन के बुलबुले के अंदर का अतिरिक्त दाब द्रव की बूंद की तुलना में कितना होता है?
o: Twice as much (4S/r vs 2S/r) because a bubble has two free surfaces
Exactly identical (2S/r)
Half of the liquid drop
Four times as much
e: Concept: Liquid drop me sirf ek bahari free surface hoti hai, isliye uske andar aur bahar ke pressure ka farq (excess pressure) = 2S/r hota hai. Soap bubble me hawa ki ek patli parat hoti hai jiske DO free surfaces hote hain (andar aur bahar), isliye usme excess pressure 2S/r ka dugna, yaani 4S/r ho jata hai. Isi kaaran ek hi radius ke liye bubble ke andar zyada pressure lagta hai aur use phulane me zyada kaam lagna hai. Exam point: 'Soap bubble = 4S/r (do surfaces); liquid drop = 2S/r'.

qe: Why does adding soaps or detergents to water improve its cleaning and wetting ability?
qh: पानी में साबुन या डिटर्जेंट मिलाने से कपड़ों की सफाई बेहतर क्यों होती है?
o: By decreasing the surface tension and contact angle of water, allowing it to penetrate narrow fabric pores
By increasing water density
By converting water into a gel
By increasing the water viscosity
e: Concept: Paani ki surface tension ki wajah se uske anu ek doosre ko kheenchte rehte hain aur kapde ke chhote chedon me ghusne se katrate hain (contact angle bada hota hai). Sabun/detergent add karne par uske anu paani ke surface tension ko kam kar dete hain aur usme 'wetting' ki kshamta badh jati hai - paani aasani se kapde ke reshe ke andar pahunchta hai, mail ko dho kar nikal jata hai. Density ya viscosity badhane ka iska koi lena-dena nahi. Exam point: 'Detergent = surface tension kam = wetting badhega'.

qe: What instrument installed in automobiles records the total cumulative distance traveled by the vehicle?
qh: वाहनों में तय की गई कुल दूरी को मापने वाला यंत्र कौन सा है?
o: Accelerometer
Tachometer
Odometer
Speedometer
e: Concept: Gaadi me lage us yantra ko 'Odometer' kehte hain jo chakkar-rotation gin kar kul chali hui doori (kilometre me) dikhata hai - ise reset nahi kiya jata, ye cumulative hota hai. 'Speedometer' usi time par chalti hui speed batata hai, 'tachometer' engine ke RPM (ghoomne ki raftaar) batata hai. Isliye distance record karne wala instrument odometer hai. Exam point: 'Total doori = Odometer; turant speed = Speedometer'. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Yahi sahi uttar Odometer hai. Is vishay ke ulte prashn bhi poochhe jaate hain, isliye dono taraf ka tathya saaf karna zaroori hai.

qe: A particle moves along a circular path of radius r. What is the magnitude of its net displacement after completing a quarter (1/4) of the circle?
qh: त्रिज्या r वाले वृत्ताकार पथ का एक-चौथाई (1/4) चक्कर लगाने के बाद विस्थापन का परिमाण क्या होगा?
o: 2r
pi * r / 2
sqrt(2) * r
Zero
e: Concept: Circular path par chalne wale kan ke 'displacement' ka matlab hai shurua (initial) aur antim (final) binduon ke beech ki seedhi doori. Chauthai (1/4) chakkar chalne par wo 90 degree ghoom jata hai - yaani centre par uska kona 90 degree ban jata hai. Ab radius r ke do perpendicular dhanchon (jaise x aur y aksh) se bane triangle ka hypotenuse = sqrt(r^2 + r^2) = r * sqrt(2). Charged particle ke path ka total path-length alag hoga (pi*r/2) par displacement r*sqrt(2) hi hai. Exam point: 'Quarter circle chalne par displacement = r * sqrt(2)'.

qe: A body is thrown vertically upward with initial velocity u. What is its velocity and acceleration at the peak of its flight?
qh: सीधे ऊपर फेंकी गई वस्तु के उच्चतम बिंदु पर वेग और त्वरण क्या होता है?
o: Velocity is zero, acceleration is zero
Velocity is u, acceleration is zero
Both velocity and acceleration are zero
Velocity is zero, acceleration is g downward
e: Concept: Jab koi vastu seedha upar phenka jata hai, to gravity uska virodh karti hai - isliye upar jaate hue uski speed ghatti jati hai. Sabse unche bindu (peak) par uska speed/velocity theek ZERO ho jata hai (us pal wo na upar, na niche jaa raha hota). Par gravity wahan bhi utni hi lagti hai - acceleration 'g' (lagbhag 9.8 m/s^2) niche ki taraf. Isliye peak par 'velocity zero, acceleration g (downward)' - in dono ko mix karne wali common galti se bachna hai. Exam point: 'Highest point par velocity 0, acceleration g (niche)'.

qe: Can an object have a constant speed and still experience acceleration?
qh: क्या किसी वस्तु की चाल नियत होते हुए भी उसमें त्वरण हो सकता है?
o: No, it violates physics principles
No, constant speed always means zero acceleration
Yes, as seen in Uniform Circular Motion where changing direction changes velocity
Yes, but only in complete vacuum
e: Concept: 'Acceleration' velocity ke badlav ki dar hai - aur velocity ek VECTOR hai (magnitude + disha). Isliye agar koi vastu gol raste par constant chaal (speed) se bhi chal rahi ho, to bhi uski DISHA har pal badal rahi hai, matlab velocity badal rahi hai, aur isliye acceleration hai (centripetal). Isliye circular motion me constant speed ke saath bhi acceleration maujood rehti hai. Constant velocity (dishe aur raftaar dono same) hone par hi acceleration zero hoti hai. Exam point: 'Constant speed + changing direction = acceleration (uniform circular motion)'.
